_npmPublishNote: nassaj-dev is an internal AGPL-3.0 fork, never published to the public npm registry. `publish` is hard-off here and package.json carries "private": true as a second, npm-level guard (release-it reads it and logs 'Skip publish: package is private.'). The old value was publish:true + publishArgs ['--access public'], which combined with the `files` array (server/, scripts/, dist-server/) would have shipped the whole backend to registry.npmjs.org on the next release run. Do not re-enable without an ADR.
